Grid 6 by 6. Zero-based ( row , col ). Rows increase down; columns increase right. Start ( 0 , 2 ). Goal ( 0 , 3 ). Obstacles ( 0 , 0 ) ; ( 2 , 4 ) ; ( 5 , 2 ).
Actions: up row minus 1; down row plus 1; left col minus 1; right col plus 1. Stay inside the grid; avoid obstacles. Execute all actions; end at the goal.
Return only a shortest path as space-separated actions.
